```{r data}
#| results: asis
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators  <- load_senators()
ns        <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes     <- load_all_votes(ns)
bills     <- load_bills() |> bill_statuses(votes)
contribs  <- load_all_contributions()
transfers <- load_intake_transfers()
fin       <- senator_finance(senators, contribs, transfers)

sen_link <- function(name, district) {
  sprintf('<a href="%s/district_%s.html">%s</a>', SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, district, name)
}
# "Name (D-16)", linked — how senators are named in money lists
sen_tag <- function(district) {
  s <- senators[match(district, senators$District), ]
  sprintf("%s (%s-%d)", sen_link(s$Name, district), s$Party, as.integer(district))
}
lb <- function(label, ranks, names, amounts) {
  cat('<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-label">', label, '</div><ol class="leaderboard">',
      paste(sprintf('<li><span class="lb-rank">%s</span><span class="lb-name">%s</span><span class="lb-amt">%s</span></li>',
                    ranks, names, amounts), collapse = ""),
      '</ol></div>', sep = "")
}
dollars <- function(value) scales::dollar(value)
```

## The Bills

```{r bills}
#| results: asis
n_passed <- sum(bills$status == "Passed Senate")
n_failed <- sum(grepl("^Failed", bills$status))
n_moving <- nrow(bills) - n_passed - n_failed

cat(sprintf('
<div class="stat-strip">
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Bills Introduced</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Passed the Senate</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Failed</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Still Moving</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
</div>', nrow(bills), n_passed, n_failed, n_moving))
```

```{r workload-table}
# Each body's docket: how many bills it has been handed, how many it has
# decided either way, and the share decided. A bill is "assigned" to a
# policy committee by referral; to Appropriations once it is fiscal AND
# has cleared its policy committee; to the Floor once it has cleared
# every committee in its path. Same pass/fail reading as the tracker.
passed  <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("pass", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
decided <- function(x) !is.na(x)
tally   <- function(code, docket, result) {
  data.frame(code = code, Assigned = nrow(docket),
             Passed = sum(passed(result)), Failed = sum(decided(result) & !passed(result)))
}
b <- bills |> mutate(code = vapply(committee, committee_code_from_name, character(1)))
workload <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c("lgl", "anr", "blh"), function(cd) {
    d <- b |> filter(!is.na(code), code == cd); tally(cd, d, d$policy_result)
  }),
  { d <- b |> filter(appropriations == "Yes", passed(policy_result)); tally("app", d, d$app_result) },
  { d <- b |> filter(passed(policy_result), appropriations == "No" | passed(app_result)); tally("floor", d, d$floor_result) }
) |>
  mutate(Body     = unname(COMMITTEE_NAMES[code]),
         Awaiting = Assigned - Passed - Failed,
         Decided  = ifelse(Assigned > 0, 100 * (Passed + Failed) / Assigned, NA))

legsim_table(workload |> select(Body, Assigned, Passed, Failed, Awaiting, Decided),
             searchable = FALSE, page_size = 5, columns = list(
  Body     = colDef(name = "Committee", minWidth = 200, cell = link_cell("", committee_url(workload$code))),
  Assigned = colDef(width = 105),
  Passed   = colDef(width = 90),
  Failed   = colDef(width = 90),
  Awaiting = colDef(width = 105),
  Decided  = colDef(name = "Worked through", width = 150, html = TRUE,
                    cell = function(value) if (is.na(value)) "&mdash;" else progress_bar_html(value))
))
```

```{r topics-chart}
#| fig-height: 4.6
# Every subject tag a bill carries (primary or secondary) counts once for
# that bill; each bar stacks where those bills stand right now.
topic_cols <- intersect(c("topic", "topic2"), names(bills))
tagged <- if (length(topic_cols) > 0) {
  bills |>
    select(bill_measure, status, all_of(topic_cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(topic_cols), values_to = "tag") |>
    filter(!is.na(tag), tag != "") |>
    mutate(stage = case_when(
      status == "Passed Senate" ~ "Passed the Senate",
      grepl("^Failed", status)  ~ "Failed",
      status == "To Floor"      ~ "Reached the floor",
      TRUE                      ~ "In committee")) |>
    distinct(bill_measure, tag, stage) |>
    count(tag, stage, name = "n")
} else data.frame()

if (nrow(tagged) == 0) {
  htmltools::p(class = "muted", "No bills carry subject tags yet.")
} else {
  stages     <- c("In committee", "Reached the floor", "Passed the Senate", "Failed")
  stage_fill <- c("In committee" = "#17345a", "Reached the floor" = "#d4a821",
                  "Passed the Senate" = "#2e6b46", "Failed" = "#a33131")
  tag_order  <- tagged |> group_by(tag) |> summarize(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(total) |> pull(tag)
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (st in stages) {
    d <- tagged |> filter(stage == st)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) next
    p <- add_bars(p, data = d, y = ~tag, x = ~n, name = st, orientation = "h",
                  marker = list(color = unname(stage_fill[st])),
                  hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}: %{x} ", tolower(st), "<extra></extra>"))
  }
  p |>
    layout(barmode = "stack",
           xaxis = list(title = "Bills", tickformat = ",d", gridcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)"),
           yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = tag_order),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.16),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible"),
           margin = list(t = 10, b = 60, l = 160, r = 20)) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

## The Votes

```{r party-unity}
#| results: asis
if (length(votes) > 0) {
  # Per senator: votes cast, votes with their party's plurality, misses.
  # "Party unity" is the standard political-science measure here: the share
  # of a member's cast votes that side with their party's position.
  unity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(senators)), function(i) {
    s <- senators[i, ]
    choice_col <- if (s$Party == "D") "Dem_choice" else "Rep_choice"
    cast <- 0; agree <- 0; missed <- 0
    for (df in votes) {
      if (!s$name_period %in% names(df)) next
      v  <- df[[s$name_period]]
      ch <- df[[choice_col]]
      is_cast <- !is.na(v) & v %in% c("Aye", "No", "Abstain")
      cast   <- cast + sum(is_cast)
      agree  <- agree + sum(is_cast & v == ch, na.rm = TRUE)
      missed <- missed + sum(is.na(v) | v == "")
    }
    data.frame(Name = s$Name, District = s$District, Party = s$Party,
               cast = cast, agree = agree, missed = missed)
  })) |>
    mutate(pct = ifelse(cast >= 5, round(100 * agree / cast), NA))

  eligible <- unity |> filter(!is.na(pct))

  cat('<div class="lb-cols">')
  for (p in c("D", "R")) {
    top <- eligible |> filter(Party == p) |>
      arrange(desc(pct), desc(cast)) |>
      mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(pct))) |>
      filter(rank <= 3)
    lb(paste0("Highest Party Unity — ", ifelse(p == "D", "Democrats", "Republicans")),
       top$rank,
       sen_link(top$Name, top$District),
       sprintf("%d%% of %d votes", top$pct, top$cast))
  }
  cat('</div><div class="lb-cols">')

  mavericks <- eligible |>
    arrange(pct, desc(cast)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(pct)) |>
    filter(rank <= 3)
  lb("The Mavericks — Most Votes Against Party",
     mavericks$rank,
     sprintf("%s (%s)", sen_link(mavericks$Name, mavericks$District), mavericks$Party),
     sprintf("%d%% with party", mavericks$pct))

  most_missed <- unity |>
    filter(missed > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(missed)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(missed))) |>
    filter(rank <= 3)
  if (nrow(most_missed) > 0) {
    lb("Most Missed Votes",
       most_missed$rank,
       sprintf("%s (%s)", sen_link(most_missed$Name, most_missed$District), most_missed$Party),
       sprintf("%d missed", most_missed$missed))
  }
  cat('</div>')
} else {
  cat('<p>No votes have been taken yet.</p>')
}
```

## The Money

```{r money}
#| results: asis
# The headline: how much of the lobby corps' money is out the door, and
# how many senators hold their goal right now. Transfers between senators
# move money around but never change the total spent.
spent     <- sum(contribs$Contribution, na.rm = TRUE)
pac_total <- sum(load_budgets()$Budget, na.rm = TRUE)
spent_pct <- if (is.na(pac_total) || pac_total == 0) NA else round(100 * spent / pac_total)
with_goal <- !is.na(fin$Goal) & fin$Goal > 0
goals_met <- sum(with_goal & fin$Balance >= fin$Goal)

cat(sprintf('
<div class="stat-strip">
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Total Spent</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span><span class="stat-sub">%s</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Goals Met</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span><span class="stat-sub">of %d senators at their fundraising goal</span></div>
</div>',
  scales::dollar(spent),
  paste0(ifelse(is.na(spent_pct), "", paste0(spent_pct, "% ")),
         "of ", scales::dollar(pac_total), " available"),
  goals_met, sum(with_goal)))

if (nrow(contribs) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="lb-cols">')

  # Senators holding the most right now (lobby money plus transfers)
  top_chest <- fin |>
    filter(Balance > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(Balance)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(Balance))) |>
    filter(rank <= 5)
  lb("Largest War Chests",
     top_chest$rank,
     sen_tag(top_chest$District),
     scales::dollar(top_chest$Balance))

  # Lobbies that spent the most
  top_spent <- contribs |>
    group_by(Lobby_Code, Lobby) |>
    summarize(total = sum(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) |>
    filter(rank <= 5)
  lb("Biggest Spenders",
     top_spent$rank,
     html_link(ifelse(is.na(top_spent$Lobby), top_spent$Lobby_Code, top_spent$Lobby),
               lobby_url(top_spent$Lobby_Code)),
     scales::dollar(top_spent$total))

  cat('</div>')

  # Money moving between senators
  if (nrow(transfers) > 0) {
    cat('<div class="lb-cols">')
    givers <- transfers |>
      group_by(District = From.District) |>
      summarize(total = sum(Amount), .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(desc(total)) |>
      mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) |>
      filter(rank <= 5)
    lb("Biggest Givers — Transfers to Other Senators",
       givers$rank, sen_tag(givers$District), scales::dollar(givers$total))
    takers <- transfers |>
      group_by(District = To.District) |>
      summarize(total = sum(Amount), .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(desc(total)) |>
      mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) |>
      filter(rank <= 5)
    lb("Most Received from Other Senators",
       takers$rank, sen_tag(takers$District), scales::dollar(takers$total))
    cat('</div>')
  }

  cat('<div class="lb-label">Money Over Time</div>')
} else {
  cat('<p>No contributions have been reported yet.</p>')
}
```

```{r money-chart}
#| fig-height: 3.2
if (nrow(contribs) > 0) {
  daily <- contribs |>
    filter(!is.na(Date)) |>
    arrange(Date) |>
    group_by(Date) |>
    summarize(day_total = sum(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(cumulative = cumsum(day_total))

  plot_ly(daily, x = ~Date, y = ~cumulative, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(color = "#17345a", width = 2.5),
          marker = list(color = "#d4a821", size = 6),
          fill = "tozeroy", fillcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)",
          hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %d}: %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "", tickprefix = "$", gridcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)"),
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible"),
      margin = list(t = 10, b = 30, l = 60, r = 20)
    ) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

<details class="table-fold">
<summary>Senators: progress toward goal</summary>

```{r goals-table}
# Column widths are tuned to fit the article column with no horizontal
# scroll (same for the tables below). Dollars are formatted in R: the
# column stays numeric (sorts by value) but shows "$90,000", not
# "$90,000.00" as reactable's own currency format insists on.
goal_tbl <- fin |>
  arrange(desc(Pct), District) |>
  transmute(Senator = Name, District, Race, Goal, Lobbies = Raised,
            Transfers = TransfersIn - TransfersOut, Balance, Progress = Pct)
# net transfers carry their sign; nothing moved shows as a dash
signed <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == 0) "—"
  else paste0(ifelse(value < 0, "−", "+"), scales::dollar(abs(value)))
}
legsim_table(goal_tbl, page_size = 40, searchable = FALSE, columns = list(
  Senator   = colDef(minWidth = 140, cell = link_cell("", sprintf("%s/district_%s.html", SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, goal_tbl$District))),
  District  = colDef(name = "SD", width = 50),
  Race      = colDef(width = 95),
  Goal      = colDef(width = 90, cell = dollars),
  Lobbies   = colDef(width = 90, cell = dollars),
  Transfers = colDef(width = 95, cell = signed),
  Balance   = colDef(width = 90, cell = dollars),
  Progress  = colDef(width = 100, html = TRUE, cell = function(value) progress_bar_html(value))
))
```
